section: 7. Path to the Netherworld: Crossing the Gate of Life and Death
description: Leaving the Human Village, following the Spring Energy light spots through the Netherworld Gate, passing the boundary path guarded by Youmu, with Spring Energy being constantly drained, everyone speeds up their journey

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Spring Energy is being siphoned away at every moment."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "A bit... nervous, can we really succeed?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Believe in yourself, let's go." #Continue leading the way forward

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "I think we should be able to."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Yes! We must succeed!"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: You step beyond the boundary of the Human Village and proceed along the path. As the path gradually disappears, turning into ordinary snowy ground, you have arrived at a snowfield swallowed by silence. The soles of your boots crush through the untouched deep snow, producing a lonely, crunching echo. Under the leaden gray sky, only the Spring Energy light points drifting against the wind, like silent fireflies, continue to guide the way ahead.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Eek!" #Quietly hugs the Baku that emerged from the shadow

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Something or other.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Gah! What is it this time?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Who is playing the violin?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Flowing light, spring blossoms fall, suddenly hearing the violin's sound, flowers fall on a desolate land, gone without the cycle of rebirth."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: No one responds; the performer is too far away.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Recites the poem while walking towards the direction of the performer

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: But the melody is beautiful.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "This melody feels somewhat unpleasant..." #Hugs the Baku tighter

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Could it be the culprit..." #Hides behind the others

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "It's a bit uncomfortable; this must be the effect of an ability."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Ugh..." #Furrows brows tightly, the loss of vision makes Ge Qing more sensitive to sound

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Quickens pace to go over and make her stop

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Supports Ge Qing "Are you alright, Miss Ge Qing?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "I'm fine..., it's just a bit grating to the ears."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Following the Spring Energy, ahead lies the end of the snowfield.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Should we get something to block our ears?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The girl tilts her head slightly, her indigo hair floating like seaweed under the agitation, the tips adorned with tiny ice crystals. The musical note ribbons on her black and white maid outfit emit a faint glow in time with the performance's rhythm. The violin body and her pale fingertips seem almost fused together. Whenever the bow grinds across the strings, translucent purple notes materialize and scatter, dyeing the Spring Energy light points that brush past her with a melancholic hue.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hello?" #Tentatively asks

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Hi." #Goes over to greet her

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "The sound is very penetrating; I'm afraid it won't be much use."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Who are you?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The girl continues playing. When the final tremolo abruptly stops, she finally looks up at you, lightly tapping the surging boundary behind her with her bow.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Hello, Lunasa. Your performance is excellent. I am Tenjouin Long'er." #Returns a bow as a greeting

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The melancholy poltergeist performer[CQ:image,file=116BB212EEBEB2B0207FABADD27C51B9.jpeg,subType=0,url=https://multimedia.nt.qq.com.cn/download?appid=1407&fileid=EhTZbB5l7UW3S1URlxEdbsB4AhEj-RighAEg_woo78TttaXCkAMyBHByb2RQgL2jAVoQNvaZWcGqyYMQ58fm7_cIR3oC__WCAQJneg&spec=0&rkey=CAISMOhgRGa_vUwK8164TWqT-Ib7PzZ5JUJQ1OkJRjOfv33SF3ZDZ1SwcTjij1336izAYw,file_size=16928]

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Can we pass through?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Thank you."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "We must return spring to Gensokyo! So please, let us pass."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Crossing that silence carries a heavier price than listening to my performance..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Please, just let us pass."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Hmm... begging won't work either."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Huh?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Music, you're quite skilled, right? I happen to know a little too."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "We can be your audience for the performance or something."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "So I'm sorry, I can't let you in."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Okay."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Without stepping into that forbidden land of the living."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "If you won't let us pass, won't it be like with Rumia again? Fighting hurts, I don't like it."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Stop."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Then... if I die here, can I enter?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "This..."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Long'er reaches into the void and pulls out an electric guitar.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "A fairy can't do that."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Generally speaking, you'd go to Lady Shikieiki's side."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I must bring spring back."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "You might also become a poltergeist like me?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "How about we compete? Whose music is stronger. If we win, you let us pass."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Naturally~"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Eye twitching

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "If I can't beat you, as the eldest daughter, there's no need for me to hold a concert either."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Hand slowly reaches towards the saw cleaver behind.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "I can sing too. Can the two of us perform together to face her?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Please."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Then let's have a contest." #Long'er hands the electric guitar to Ge Qing, then takes out a keyboard that can be worn on the back and hands it to Luo Xueyu, and two maracas, handing them to Lina.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "But if we don't end this eternal winter, everyone will hide in their homes. Who will come to see your performance then?" #poses a sharp, somewhat untimely question

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Isn't the Human Village quite lively?" She tilted her head. "It'll be fine once spring passes."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Sorry for the trouble, everyone. I'll use my ability to animate the instruments. You can use your abilities to assist."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Huh? Miss Ge Qing has a point." #hand leaves the saw cleaver behind her, takes the offered instrument. "I... I'm not very good at this..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "That one just wants to collect some things. Wait a few months until summer and the harsh winter will disappear."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Spring has already all gone to the Netherworld. Gensokyo will have no more spring."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "It won't be lively for much longer."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Even without spring, there's still summer." "It's just one season. As a poltergeist, I don't really get those things. Is the difference that big?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "That won't do. I don't agree with having no spring or anything like that. What are we supposed to do then?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Let's settle this with one song. No more dragging our feet."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Naturally~"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .st shm+6

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Mugen Tenjoin Long'er]'s 'Existence Record'... Updated: [SHM]: 10+6=16

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Well then, let's give it a try." Lunasa elegantly placed the bow on the violin strings, then drew out a series of sharp tremolos. She deliberately let the bow slip on the strings, producing three discordant notes, while her left hand rapidly vibrated on the fingerboard, creating a mocking ripple. The final trailing note was lifted high by the bow, transforming into a shattered purple arc of light that splashed at everyone's feet. "Do your best~" Undoubtedly, this was a provocation.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Then let's begin." #Long'er puts on his Messiah Fist gauntlets and takes a position in the center of the group. His right hand rests on his waist, activating the recording function on his phone.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Ge Qing has never seen such a thing before. She can only start by feeling the guitar with her hands.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "The instruments will become animated. Just use your abilities normally."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Is this... a pipa?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Examines the instrument in hand carefully. "Such a novel thing."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Covers the maracas with morning glories to create a microphone effect. "Singing is one of the few things I'm good at."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "It seems you can't even grasp the basics of the music, can you? www" Lunasa mocks at the opportune moment.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Long'er raises his left hand, the one wearing the Messiah gauntlet, high. He takes a deep, full breath, then exhales a little. Subsequently, his left hand falls, striking the empty space before him. An illusory yellow drumhead is struck into existence, water droplets on it flying out and scattering with the drumhead's vibration. "Thump! Thump! Thump! Thump!" #His hands seem to transform into drumsticks beating a large drum before him, striking forcefully at a heartbeat-like rhythm. #Then, the instruments in everyone's hands are awakened by this drumming and begin, one by one, to join the drum's performance.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Mugen Tenjoin Long'er]'s 'Soul Hunt' Check: Roll: 1D20+Psychic Power(3)d4+4d4+2d6=9+{2+2+3}(7)+{1+4+3+1}(9)+{2+2}(4)=29 Challenge: 10 Success Success Level: 4

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .sh Psychic Power d4+4d4+2d6

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "..." #Makes the emotions of the living instrument in her hands even more intense.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #After getting somewhat familiar with the keyboard in hand, relying on musical knowledge and recalling childhood songs, does her utmost to play harmonious melodies in sync with her teammates.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .st shm+4+4

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Mugen Tenjoin Long'er]'s 'Existence Record'... Updated: [SHM]: 16+4+4=24

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "...I did my best."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Takes a deep breath. "Then I'll begin." Lina tightly grips the microphone in her hand, pouring her all into her song as she has always done. As the music starts, new buds break through the layers of snow and sprout. Petals also grow on Lina's body, scattering in the wind. At this moment, Lina stands upon a stage that belongs solely to her, blooming into the most dazzling flower.
